path.?dataset_path: The dataset path, whish stores the datasets
path.?train_result_path: The path to store the training results
path.?test_result_path: The path to store the testing results

tiff_cut.?source_image: Path to the large TIFF image that needs to be sliced
tiff_cut.?source_label: YOLO-format label file (normalized coords) that matches the source image
tiff_cut.?output_dir: Directory that will receive the cropped tiles (images/ & labels/)
tiff_cut.?overlap_rate: Fractional overlap between image tiles (e.g. 0.2 = 20% overlap)
tiff_cut.?save_empty: Whether to export tiles without any boxes
tiff_cut.?output_ext: Image extension for the exported tiles

pretrained_model.?pretrained_model_path: The pre_trained_model uesd for fine-tuning or testing

train.?train_MAR1: The training parameters for MAR1 dataset

train_MAR1.?batch_size: The batch size used for training
train_MAR1.?img_size: The image size used for training
train_MAR1.?epochs: The number of epochs used for training
train_MAR1.?lr: The learning rate used for training
train_MAR1.?patience: The patience used for training, if serveral epochs no improvement, then stop training
train_MAR1.?data_yaml_path: The data yaml path for MAR1 dataset

train_AIR-SARShip.?batch_size: The batch size used for training
train_AIR-SARShip.?img_size: The image size used for training
train_AIR-SARShip.?epochs: The number of epochs used for training
train_AIR-SARShip.?lr: The learning rate used for training
train_AIR-SARShip.?patience: The patience used for training, if serveral epochs no improvement, then stop training
train_AIR-SARShip.?data_yaml_path: The data yaml path for AIR-SARShip dataset

validate_MAR1.?subdataset: The subdataset used for validation, may containing: test,train,val
validate_MAR1.?validate_model_path: The model path used for validation
validate_MAR1.?data_yaml_path: The data yaml path for MAR1 dataset

validate_AIR-SARShip.?subdataset: The subdataset used for validation, may containing: test,train,val
validate_AIR-SARShip.?validate_model_path: The model path used for validation
validate_AIR-SARShip.?data_yaml_path: The data yaml path for AIR-SARShip dataset

test_MAR1.?test_img_path: The image path used for testing
test_MAR1.?output_path: The output path to store the testing results
test_MAR1.?weights_path: The model weights path used for testing

test_AIR-SARShip.?test_img_path: The image path used for testing
test_AIR-SARShip.?output_path: The output path to store the testing results
test_AIR-SARShip.?weights_path: The model weights path used for testing

visualization.?target_patch_size: Detection crop size (pixels) when exporting target-centered sub-images
visualization.?patch_output_dir: Directory used to store exported detection sub-images
